entity.n.01.definition: That which is perceived or known or inferred to have its own distinct existence

physical_entity.n.01.definition: An entity that has physical existence

abstraction.n.06.definition: A general concept formed by extracting common features from specific examples

agent.n.01.definition: An active and efficient cause; capable of producing a certain effect

organism.n.01.definition: A living thing that has the ability to act or function independently

artifact.n.01.definition: A man-made object taken as a whole

computation.n.02.definition: The procedure of calculating or determining something by mathematical or logical methods

communication.n.02.definition: The activity of communicating; the activity of conveying information
